$comment: The harness catalog. The frontend-harness skill reads it to suggest modules; tasks/apply.mjs reads it to install them. A module's `templates` (configs and .claude/rules) live in template/: Copier renders them per framework and modules and merges them with the project's edits; copier.yml `_exclude` leaves out those of unselected modules. Its `files` live in library/ (laid out like a project) and are copied whole to the same path, since projects never edit them. A `group` takes exactly `pick` of its modules; `default` names the one to use per framework when the project shows none. Skills are listed in skills.json.

linter.describe: The linter the hooks and checks run.

sections.Several agents at once:
- Several agents may work in this repo at the same time, all on `main`. Changes you did not make are another agent's work in progress, not a mess to clean up.
- Touch only your own changes. Never revert, reformat, stash or commit another agent's files.
- Before editing a file, check `git status`. If it has changes you did not make, tell the user which file and wait instead of editing it.
- If the end-of-turn checks fail, first make sure none of the failures come from your own changes. If they all sit in another agent's files, finish with one short line saying so; do not analyse, list or fix them.
- Commit only your own files (`git add <paths>`, never `git add -A`).
